correctness.rationale: The explicit family has dilatation omega(z)=z and positive Jacobian. Its analytic part has exact starlike order beta by a Möbius positive-real-part identity. A boundary Taylor expansion of H=h-g and the implicit-function theorem produce conjugate interior points with equal harmonic image whenever N>3 beta/[2(1-beta)].

originality.rationale: The 2015 source explicitly asks for the sharp order threshold. Earlier literature contains an order-zero counterexample but targeted comparisons did not locate an all-orders family reaching arbitrarily close to one or an equivalent negative resolution. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with a documented residual risk from Janowski-starlike and differently parameterized literature.

value.rationale: The theorem rules out every nondegenerate candidate threshold below one, gives an explicit family with exact prescribed starlike order, and identifies a reusable boundary-fold mechanism for loss of injectivity.
